FORGE-BURNT_SCAR.title: Burnt Scar
FORGE-BURNT_SCAR.description: At the start of the next combat, shuffle {BurnCount} [blue]Burns[/blue] into your Draw Pile.
FORGE-FRIENDLY_CUBE.title: Friendly Cube
FORGE-FRIENDLY_CUBE.description: At the start of combat, gain {BufferAmount} [blue]Buffer[/blue]. Lose this relic when you take unblocked damage.
